items.title: Why Is Equifax (EFX) Warning Of Canada’s Highest Mortgage Delinquencies In 13 Years?
items.summary: Equifax (NYSE:EFX) reports that mortgage delinquencies in Canada have reached a 13 year high as interest rates rise. The credit bureau says nearly one quarter of Canadian mortgage holders are under significant financial pressure from higher borrowing costs. Equifax Canada highlights condominium owners, recent homebuyers and younger borrowers as groups showing heightened signs of repayment stress. items.summary: The part of Fair Isaac that could change the case for its stock is software, not the credit score. Banks use this software to decide on loans, catch fraud and collect debts. You may still think of Fair Isaac only as the company behind the FICO score that mortgage lenders check.
